# INFI Raises $12 Million to Revolutionize Self-Service Technology

February 04, 2025 09:45 ET | Source: INFI INFI

---

CHICAGO, Feb. 04, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- INFI USA, a pioneering AI-driven self-service software platform, today announced $12 million in Series A funding to accelerate technological innovation, expand its team, and broaden market reach. The round was led by MK Capital.

"Our Series A funding marks a pivotal moment for INFI USA," said Lucas Liu, CEO of INFI USA. "This investment will propel our mission to transform traditional business interactions through cutting-edge self-service technology that empowers businesses and delights consumers."

INFI USA's innovative platform leverages AI to create seamless, intuitive self-service experiences across kiosks, tablets, and smartphones. By automating operations and enhancing consumer interactions, the company is redefining service models for retail businesses of all sizes—from local cafes to national restaurant chains.

The past year has been transformative for INFI USA, with revenue growing and partnerships expanding to include prominent brands such as:

- Cilantro Taco Grill
- PJ's Coffee
- Qargo Coffee
- Randy's Donuts
- Wafels and Dinges

These partnerships now span all 50 states, demonstrating the platform's versatility and appeal across diverse markets.

With this new funding, INFI USA plans to deepen integrations with industry-leading technology partners, including Stripe, Revel, NCR, Lightspeed, Square, Toast and Oracle.

"This investment enables us to help INFI push the boundaries of what’s possible in self-service technology,” said Mark Koulogeorge, Managing Partner at MK Capital. “With our deep expertise in scaling software companies, we are committed to providing strategic guidance and operational support to help INFI anticipate and meet the evolving needs of modern businesses.”

The funds will be primarily allocated to - accelerating research and development, recruiting top-tier talent, expanding market presence, and enhancing technological capabilities.

About INFI USA INFI USA is a tech company specializing in self-service solutions that transform consumer interactions and business operations. By combining cutting-edge artificial intelligence with user-centric design, INFI USA helps businesses create more efficient, engaging, and personalized service experiences.

About MK Capital MK Capital is an early and growth-stage venture capital firm with more than $500 million in assets under management. MK invests in disruptive business-to-business software and technology companies. The MK partners average over twenty years of venture capital experience and have built dozens of leading companies in their chosen markets. As a member of the MK Capital portfolio, companies gain access to experienced partners with deep operating experience, not just a line of capital. INFI USA Secures $12 Million in Series A Led by MK Capital

# INFI USA Secures $12 Million in Series A Led by MK Capital

Last Updated: 4 February 2025

By Ekaterina Pisareva Co-founder of JustAINews 

Key Points

- INFI USA secured $12M in Series A funding, led by MK Capital, to enhance AI-driven self-service solutions.
- The company plans to expand technology capabilities, deepen software integrations, and recruit top-tier talent.
- Strategic partnerships with industry leaders will support INFI USA’s mission to transform self-service experiences.

Credits: Erik Mclean / Unsplash

INFI USA, an AI-driven self-service software platform, has raised $12 million in Series A funding to advance its technology and accelerate growth. The round was led by MK Capital, marking a significant milestone for the company as it looks to redefine self-service experiences across industries.

While the company's valuation remains undisclosed, this funding round positions INFI USA for substantial expansion. The investment highlights confidence in its technology, which aims to streamline business operations through AI-powered kiosks, tablets, and mobile solutions.

## Revolutionizing customer interactions through AI

> "Our Series A funding marks a pivotal moment for INFI USA. This investment will propel our mission to transform traditional business interactions through cutting-edge self-service technology that empowers businesses and delights consumers."
> 
> Lucas Liu, CEO of INFI USA

By integrating AI-driven automation, INFI USA enhances self-service experiences across kiosks, tablets, and smartphones. The platform’s ability to reduce operational costs while improving efficiency has made it a game-changer for businesses ranging from local cafes to national restaurant chains.

## Where the funding will go

With the newly secured capital, INFI USA will focus on expanding its technology capabilities, deepening integrations with industry-leading software providers, and growing its team. Some key investment areas include:

- Advancing AI capabilities to make self-service solutions even more intuitive and seamless.
- Strengthening partnerships with major platforms like Stripe, Revel, NCR, Lightspeed, Square, Toast, and Oracle to improve payment processing and operational efficiencies.
- Expanding market presence to reach more businesses nationwide.

Additionally, INFI USA aims to recruit top-tier talent, particularly in software development and AI research, ensuring the company remains at the forefront of innovation in self-service technology.

## The story behind INFI USA

Founded in 2016 by Lucas Liu, INFI USA has rapidly grown into a leader in self-service technology. With a mission to make transactions more efficient, cost-effective, and user-friendly, the company has developed an ecosystem that allows businesses of all sizes to automate operations without sacrificing customer experience.

About INFI — Restaurant Self-Ordering Technology Company

Feature of the Month INFI SITES — a website your guests actually order from Explore

About INFI

# Built by operators.Backed by innovators.

Designed to help every restaurant thrive — INFI adds self-ordering, loyalty, and marketing on top of the POS you already run.

Book a Demo See the platform

Our story

## How one founder reimagined restaurant tech.

INFI began with founder Lucas Liu's firsthand experience inside restaurant operations. After moving to Chicago in 2013 to invest in restaurants, Lucas spent years working in the business — from running the POS at Little Lamb Mongolian hot pot (with a karaoke bar upstairs) to investing in a QSR boba tea shop.

Motivated to find a better way, Lucas experimented with tech solutions early on, including a Groupon-style platform he built from scratch. But it wasn't until he saw McDonald's new ordering kiosks that the idea clicked: independent restaurants needed the same labor-saving tools, built for their scale.

He built the first INFI kiosk for a friend's restaurant, studying how customers used it and refining the design. That prototype led to a patent and acceptance into the Polsky Exchange Incubator at the University of Chicago, where Lucas connected with the designer behind the McDonald's and Panera kiosks — someone who helped validate and strengthen the vision.

INFI was founded with a simple mission: help restaurants thrive with technology that reduces labor strain, enhances guest experience, and preserves every brand's uniqueness.

Turning moments into momentum

## Six years, milestone by milestone.

2019

INFI launches in beta with its first integration: Square POS.

2020

Secures its first multi-location client, Seoul Taco, just before the pandemic — proving the kiosk's value during unprecedented times.

2021

Raises seed funding and launches the INFI mobile app.

2022

Expands nationally, serving restaurants across the U.S.

2023

Introduces the K3 hardware line, adds Revel and Clover integrations, and begins supporting midsize chains, food festivals, and concession operations.

2024

Releases a new software console and moves toward true POS agnosticism with the addition of Lightspeed POS.

2025

Closes Series A funding to accelerate innovation and launches Toast POS integration.

Leadership with purpose

## The team behind the platform.

### Lucas Liu

Founder & CEO

Lucas Liu leads INFI's vision and product strategy, drawing on his deep background in technology, engineering, and restaurant operations. Holding a PhD in Engineering and technology patents, Lucas founded INFI after years of firsthand experience working in and investing in restaurants. His unique blend of academic expertise and operational insight drives INFI's commitment to building intuitive, impactful technology for restaurants.
